title: Gear Up: What We Brought and Why

slides.title: Gear Up: What We Brought and Why
slides.subtitle: Talk about the things we pack, and why we need them

slides.prompt: What's the one item you always pack, no matter the trip?

lines.text: Have you packed your gear for the hike yet?
lines.speaker: leo

lines.text: Almost! I packed my boots and a jacket, in order to stay warm.
lines.speaker: maya

lines.text: Good idea. I'm bringing a first-aid kit, just in case there's an emergency.
lines.speaker: leo

lines.text: That's essential! What's it for, exactly?
lines.speaker: maya

lines.text: So that we can help each other if someone gets hurt.
lines.speaker: leo

lines.text: Smart! I'm also packing snacks, so that we don't get hungry on the trail.
lines.speaker: maya

slides.prompt: Listen to the conversation again. Now practice saying these key phrases out loud, just like Leo and Maya!

slides.title: Leo's Weekend Trip Prep
slides.passage: Leo was excited for his weekend trip to the mountains with his friends. He needed to pack his bag carefully. First, he gathered all his hiking gear: sturdy boots, a waterproof jacket, and a headlamp. These items were essential for safety on the trails. He always carried a first-aid kit, too, just in case of an emergency. The main purpose of the trip was to explore nature and relax, so he also packed a good book.

slides.question: What was the main purpose of Leo's trip?

slides.statement: Leo packed his hiking gear because it was essential for safety.

slides.question: Why did Leo pack a first-aid kit?

slides.rule: Use 'to + base verb' to explain the purpose of an action.
slides.title: To + infinitive

rows.b: so that he wouldn't get hungry.
so that her phone wouldn't die.
so that they could help each other.

slides.rule: Use 'so that + subject + verb' when the purpose needs a full clause.
slides.title: So that + clause

slides.rule: Subject + verb + object + to/in order to/so that + purpose.
slides.title: Leo packed a first-aid kit to be safe.

blueprint_ref.title: Gear Up: What We Brought and Why
blueprint_ref.objective: Students will be able to describe their past preparations for a jungle expedition using past tenses.
blueprint_ref.unit_theme: Introduction to jungle environments and basic survival gear.

story_state.arc: The journey begins as we recall our initial preparations for entering the vast, unknown jungle.
story_state.theme: Introduction to jungle environments and basic survival gear.

blueprint_ref.communication_goal: Students will describe what they packed and why it's essential for jungle survival.
pronunciation_focus: /d/ vs /t/ sounds in past tense verbs

lesson_blueprint.grammar: Clauses of purpose (to + infinitive, in order to, so that)
lesson_blueprint.interests: Travel planning, outdoor adventures, being prepared for unexpected situations
lesson_blueprint.specific_needs: Help students differentiate between 'to + infinitive' and 'so that' when explaining purpose.
lesson_blueprint.final_output_task: Students will present a 'packing list' for a hypothetical trip or event, explaining each item of gear and its purpose using clauses of purpose.
lesson_blueprint.learning_objective: Student will be able to describe and justify the purpose of items needed for a specific activity or situation.
